theorems.name: Submission.lcmp_exists_good_slice_level
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (ν κ : ℕ → Measure (Euclid P)) (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (a b : ℝ), Measurable f → a < b → (∀ j, ν j {x | a < f x ∧ f x < b} < ∞) → Tendsto (fun j => ν j {x | a < f x ∧ f x < b}) atTop (𝓝 0) → (∀ j, κ j {x | a < f x ∧ f x < b} < ∞) → ∃ t ∈ Ioo a b, ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧ (∀ j, κ j {x | f x = t} = 0) ∧ (∀ j, liminf (fun h : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal h⁻¹ * ν j {x | t - h < f x ∧ f x < t}) (𝓝[>] 0) < ∞) ∧ Tendsto (fun j => liminf (fun h : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal h⁻¹ * ν (φ j) {x | t - h < f x ∧ f x < t}) (𝓝[>] 0)) atTop (𝓝 0)
